result.instructions: Past support tickets for this billing product. Use it to see what was already tried on an account, or what other agents did about an error code and whether it worked.

tools.description: Past support tickets for one account, newest last. Use this when the customer says a problem has happened before, or when you need to know what has already been tried on their account. Takes an account id like ACC-1180. It knows nothing about accounts it has no tickets for.
tools.name: get_ticket_history

tools.description: What other agents did about one error code, and whether it worked. Use this after you know the documented fix, to check whether that fix has actually held before. Takes one code like ERR-4032. This is history, not policy: the help centre says what the fix is, this says how it went.
tools.name: find_similar_tickets

content.text:
Past tickets mentioning ERR-4032:

[SUP-2041] 2026-08-14  account ACC-1180  ERR-4032
  what happened: Invoice line rejected after migration.
  what the agent did: Re-mapped the line to a current tax code, reissued.
  outcome: resolved

[SUP-2114] 2026-09-02  account ACC-1180  ERR-4032
  what happened: Same invoice line failed again on the next run.
  what the agent did: Re-mapped again. Root cause was an unmapped legacy code on the product.
  outcome: escalated to Billing Ops

agent.ticket: Account ACC-1180 is hitting ERR-4032 on an invoice line again. What is the documented fix, and has this account seen it before?
agent.answer: The documented fix for ERR-4032 is to re-map the line item to a current tax code under Billing then Tax Codes, then reissue the invoice [HC-4002-structured-004]. Yes, account ACC-1180 has seen this error before: it occurred on 2026-08-14 (SUP-2041) and again on 2026-09-02 (SUP-2114), where the same invoice line failed again and was escalated to Billing Ops due to an unmapped legacy code on the product [SUP-2041] [SUP-2114].
